notes.title: Pumped BMX Version 1.1 Out Now
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We've released a patch today that should fix some of the problems that players were experiencing, especially when it comes to the games controls. Full Patch Notes below:

Xbox One controllers now working on Windows 10
Mouse cursor now hidden when using a controller
Logitech controllers should now work
Button glyphs should now show up when using a controller
​Bike sounds restored on Raise the Roof level
Mouse works on the tutorial menus​
